name: ecrin-finance-integration
description: Fold the two TAME finance tools (Comptes & Budget, Investissement) into the Écrin socle as native domains, in a single self-extracting offline HTML file.

scripts.build: npm run debundle && npm run modules && npm run assemble && npm run rebundle && npm run verify
scripts.test: node tools/smoke.mjs && node tools/nonreg.mjs && node tools/test-jsdom.mjs && node tools/test-fullflow.mjs && node tools/screenshot.mjs
